scientific_question: After rejecting output-side correction at equal coordinate count, what is the smallest task-selected hidden-only Givens depth that materially increases both current exact-Muon update recovery and held-out phase-chord recovery while retaining a conservative projected MFU above the 20 percent launch floor?

causal_protocol.selection_and_angle_fit: current exact coherent Muon update only
causal_protocol.held_out_scoring: the dense c_proj phase chord from the current boundary to the next registered boundary
causal_protocol.refresh_cadence_interpretation: Each cell selects connectivity at a registered 60-update phase boundary, matching the production r60 cadence. No r120 claim is made because optimizer-state probes exist only at these boundaries.

performance_budget.projection: Conservatively hold all non-optimizer time fixed and scale the entire measured optimizer time linearly with stage count. This over-attributes fixed optimizer work to Givens depth.

selection_rule.pass: Prepare an immutable selected-depth r60 config, verify exact resume at that depth, and directly poll a real BF16 1-warmup-plus-61-update MFU preflight that includes update-60 rematching. Do not launch scientific training until those checks and a separate immutable training decision are recorded.
selection_rule.fail: Close stage-count expansion as an insufficient structural fix; do not run another language-model candidate, and return to a qualitatively different hidden-direction generator rather than output, gain, or low-rank residual additions.

execution_policy: Run directly in the foreground on one idle Y400 GPU and poll to exit. Do not use a watchdog, callback, queue worker, heartbeat, or PRO6.
